Title: Can you use Anarch Converts special on an Anarch Vampire to cycle your crypt?

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
I just compared the wordings of the "Go Anarch" action from the rulebook with the Anarch Convert:

> Anarch Convert
> Anarch
> As the convert enters play, you can remove him from the game to make a non-titled vampire you control Anarch and either gain 1 pool or draw 1 card from your crypt.
>
> 10.4. Anarchs
> Anarch is a sect on its own. An untitled non-Anarch vampire can change sect and become an anarch as a +1 stealth undirected action that costs 2 blood (or 1 blood if the controller controls at least 1 other ready anarch).
>
Since the convert is missing the "non-Anarch" requirement, does that mean, I can target a vampire, that already is Anarch to cycle the Convert?

Messages.Author: Ke.
Messages.Body:
Yes, you can.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hobbesgoblin wrote:
>
> Since the convert is missing the "non-Anarch" requirement, does that mean, I can target a vampire, that already is Anarch to cycle the Convert?
>
Sure, provided the vampire is not titled. The Anarch Conver's ability is not related to the "go anarch" action.
